name: Stacks the Cardboard-Tan Cat
blurb: Stacks, a big broad-chested cat with a cardboard-tan coat, cream bib and cream paws, naps on a tall pile of brown boxes in the garden shed.

name: Roastie the Golden-Crust Cat
blurb: Roastie, a plump shorthair with a glossy golden-brown coat and herb-green eyes, dozes in the warmest sunny patch beside the garden grill.

name: Toastbun the Long Ginger Cat
blurb: Toastbun, a long, low ginger tabby with toasty bun-brown stripes and a cream belly, stretches the full length of the garden bench.
